t: Diamonds in the Rough? Best Hidden Gem Metros for Homeownership
s: July 22, 2024 - Huntsville, Ala., is the best hidden gem metro for homeownership. The metro doesn’t rank first in any individual category, but its general affordability for homeowners and strong showing in multiple categories help it rise to the top. For example, Huntsville homeowners with a mortgage spend only 17.5% of their income on median monthly housing costs — the second-lowest among the metros analyzed.
